meta.method: Read named sources; one point per (source, location); Nominatim geocode inside AOI bbox, 1 req/s; manual neighbourhood centre only if Nominatim missed.
meta.notes: Quotes are verbatim excerpts ≤ 25 words. Ifo, Ogun (TheCable) omitted — outside AOI. Punch dates the 10-hour rain Wednesday 4 July as published; ThisDay/BBC/Channels describe Wednesday 3 July. No locations, times or quotes were inferred beyond the text.

review.notes: Quotes verified verbatim for Vanguard, ThisDay, Daily Trust, BBC Pidgin, Daily Post, Punch; TheCable unverifiable (blocked, no archive). Geocoder matched street names over places (Majek, Abijo, Lekki); corrections are marked "review:" in geocode_method. Corrections matched by location_name after IDs were renumbered by a concurrent re-run.
